source: G&V on ticket 823 (sockets for the PK4 kit items, the last open part of needs-planner): each kit item that shows on the rig names one vehicle-attach point outside those #809-#816 own and outside MODULE_ATTACH_POINTS. The Cache Crate has none: it is a placed world object drawn at its cell, held crates only a HUD count. Until the Blender art (design + tier:fable) each socket draws a flat placeholder part, inside the rig's outline at every state, off the drill tip and the colliders (the LK1 guard); placeholder sizes and colours are tuned by eye.

sockets.shows: A scree cowl over the drill collar, blades swept back; they flex outward when it shoves rubble.
A small rack by the cab with one flask per held flask, up to the stack limit of 3; a bottled flask glows faintly.
A gripper arm mirroring the mobility arm on hull.arm.right; it closes on a lifted spinecrystal, which rides in its jaws.
A folded brass vane on the roof that fans open while it rides a vent blast and folds shut afterwards.
